name: Build Plugins

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'manifests/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/build.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'manifests/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/build.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20.x]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Build Script
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/build-plugins.sh
          ./scripts/build-plugins.sh

      - name: Validate Built Plugins
        run: |
          # Ensure plugins directory exists and is not empty
          if [ ! -d "plugins" ]; then
            echo "::error::Plugins directory not found after build"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for symlinks (should be none in built output)
          SYMLINKS=$(find plugins -type l)
          if [ ! -z "$SYMLINKS" ]; then
            echo "::error::Found symlinks in built plugins. Built plugins must be self-contained."
            echo "$SYMLINKS"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify specific expected plugins exist (example: ork)
          if [ ! -d "plugins/ork" ]; then
            echo "::error::Main plugin 'ork' not found in build output"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify JSON validity of generated manifests if any are copied
          find plugins -name "*.json" -exec sh -c 'python3 -m json.tool "$1" > /dev/null || { echo "::error::Invalid JSON in $1"; exit 1; }' _ {} \;

      - name: Upload Build Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-plugins
          path: plugins/
          retention-days: 5
